lore_anchors.definition: A disguise secret art from the Profound Yin Scripture that allows the user to alter height, muscle structure, and skin color. The cost: only 70% of mana can be used while active.
The peak stage just below Foundation Establishment, where a cultivator’s energy is nearly condensed into a pseudo-core. Not yet a true Foundation Establishment cultivator.
A rare spiritual herb that grows in the vicinity of high-grade demonic beasts. Used in alchemy or cultivation breakthroughs.
An invitation-only, mobile trading hub for mid-to-high-level cultivators. Requires personal introduction to enter, and its location changes frequently to avoid beast attacks.
A stage where medicinal pills alone can no longer advance cultivation; progress requires personal insight, karmic luck, or life-or-death combat. A classic narrative trope in xianxia.
